_readme: THE EVIDENCE LEDGER: every dated public claim, and what proves it.
tools/seo/build-newsroom.mjs renders newsroom.html and feed.xml from this file.
An entry reaches the public site ONLY when both are true:
verification_status == "verified"   (a person opened the evidence and it says what the entry says)
Anything else stays here, with the reason, and is never rendered.
event_date is when the thing happened. publish_date is when this site first
published the entry. They are different fields on purpose: an entry is never
backdated, and the newsroom shows both dates when they differ.
This file lives under docs/, which the Pages deploy strips from the published
tree. It is internal; the newsroom is its public rendering.

entries.event: Connecticut General Assembly Official Citations for Matthew McCluster and McCluster Corp
entries.headline: Connecticut General Assembly issues official citations to Matthew McCluster and McCluster Corp
entries.summary: The Connecticut General Assembly issued two Official Citations dated October 5, 2025 at the State Capitol in Hartford: one to Matthew Christian Perry McCluster, recognizing his leadership across arts, media and community organizing as founder of McCluster Corp and creator of the fellowship then called Equity Rise, and one to McCluster Corp for its programs advancing cultural equity, environmental justice and religious freedom. Both are signed by the President Pro Tempore of the Senate, the Speaker of the House and the Secretary of the State.
factual_claims: Two Official Citations, both dated October 5, 2025, State Capitol, Hartford
One names Matthew Christian Perry McCluster, one names McCluster Corp
Signed by the President Pro Tempore, the Speaker of the House and the Secretary of the State
The citations name the program Equity Rise, its name in October 2025
entries.supporting_evidence: Scans of both signed citations, inspected 2026-10-02

entries.event: State of Georgia Governor's Proclamation: Georgia Youth Innovation & Civic Leadership Week
entries.headline: Governor Kemp proclaims Georgia Youth Innovation & Civic Leadership Week, citing McCluster Corp's Equity Uprise Fellowship
entries.summary: Governor Brian P. Kemp signed a proclamation on October 27, 2025 declaring December 12 to 18, 2025 Georgia Youth Innovation & Civic Leadership Week. It cites McCluster Corp, founded by Matthew McCluster, for expanding its Equity Uprise Fellowship to Georgia, and the 2025 summer cohort's environmental-justice and digital-literacy projects.
factual_claims: Signed and sealed October 27, 2025 by Governor Brian P. Kemp, attested by the Chief of Staff
Proclaims December 12-18, 2025 as Georgia Youth Innovation & Civic Leadership Week
Names McCluster Corp, founded by Matthew McCluster, and its Equity Uprise Fellowship
entries.supporting_evidence: Scan of the signed proclamation, inspected 2026-10-02
target_queries: Georgia Youth Innovation and Civic Leadership Week
entries.note: Earlier copy on the site dated this 'December 2025'. December 12-18 is the week it proclaims; the document was signed October 27, 2025.

entries.event: Equity Uprise event in Bridgeport on Docket 516 and environmental justice
entries.headline: Equity Uprise holds its October 5 event in Bridgeport
entries.summary: On October 5, 2025 the Equity Uprise fellowship held an event in Bridgeport. The City of Bridgeport's proclamation of December 10, 2025 says the event "transformed the discussion around environmental-justice concerns in Docket 516" through art, music and policy dialogue. Matthew McCluster photographed it.
factual_claims: The event took place in Bridgeport on October 5 (2025)
The City of Bridgeport proclamation of December 10, 2025 describes it as the fellowship's October 5 Bridgeport event and connects it to Docket 516
Matthew McCluster's photographs of it are on the site
entries.supporting_evidence: City of Bridgeport proclamation text; photo wall
entries.note: The venue is not stated: data/gallery.json says Shiloh Baptist Church and data/portfolio.json titles a frame 'Zion Baptist · the room'. Resolve before naming a venue.

Describes Equity Uprise 2025 as a civic fellowship created by Bridgeport native Matthew McCluster and McCluster Corp

entries.owner_action: The scan on file is cropped along its right edge, cutting the ends of several lines. Replace it with a complete scan.

entries.event: Policy memorandum on mandatory DNA collection from misdemeanor offenders
entries.headline: Matthew McCluster's policy memorandum on DNA collection from misdemeanor offenders
entries.summary: Matthew McCluster wrote a policy memorandum, addressed to Governor Brian Kemp and dated November 29, 2024, opposing legislation to mandate DNA collection from people convicted of misdemeanors on constitutional, equity, fiscal and efficacy grounds. It was his writing sample for the Urban Leadership Fellowship and is published in full.
factual_claims: Sole author; dated November 29, 2024; addressed to Governor Brian Kemp
Submitted as his Urban Leadership Fellowship writing sample
entries.supporting_evidence: The memorandum itself, published on the site
target_queries: DNA collection misdemeanor Georgia policy memo
entries.note: The document is the author's own; the entry claims only that it was written and published, not that the Governor's office received it.

entries.event: Résumé claims checked against the IPC engagement document
entries.summary: The IPC engagement document's cover page is titled 'Infrastructure Associate'; both résumé pages give the IPC role as 'Infrastructure Engineer'. The document also lists 'Provide instruction to new team members' under the heading 'Leadership (Kevin)', while the résumé claims 'instructed new team members'. The IT résumé additionally lists Active Directory, Microsoft 365, imaging and ticketing at IPC, which the document does not mention.
entries.owner_action: Confirm the job title of record with PeopleSERVE/IPC and align both résumé pages (an employment check reports the title of record), and confirm or remove the instruction and IPC-specific Microsoft 365/Active Directory bullets. entries.event: Connecticut Siting Council denies UI's reconsideration petition; Docket 516R closed
entries.headline: Siting Council rejects UI's monopole appeal; Docket 516R is closed
entries.summary: On February 5, 2026 the Connecticut Siting Council rejected United Illuminating's petition for reconsideration of its Fairfield to Congress Railroad Transmission Line 115-kV Rebuild Project, which the Council had denied 5-3 on October 16, 2025. The final reconsideration decision is dated February 9, 2026, and the Council lists Docket 516R as closed. Equity Uprise's October 5, 2025 event in Bridgeport had focused on this docket, and the plain-English record of the case is now the front page of the Equity Uprise group.
factual_claims: Council vote to deny the application, 5-3, October 16, 2025 (CT Mirror); remand decision documents dated October 17, 2025 (CSC)
Petition for reconsideration rejected February 5, 2026 (CT Mirror); final reconsideration decision dated February 9, 2026 (CSC)
Docket 516R status: closed (CSC)
No claim that Equity Uprise or any one party caused the outcome
entries.supporting_evidence: Connecticut Siting Council Docket 516R page and CT Mirror reporting, checked 2026-10-03
